summary: WF Card Funding LLC filed an 8-K regarding the expected issuance of Class A(2026-1) Notes by WF Card Issuance Trust on April 27, 2026. This is a routine asset-backed securities shelf takedown under the Indenture dated November 14, 2023. The filing exhibits include an underwriting agreement, terms agreement, and depositor certification. No special-situation M&A, activism, restructuring, or capital return event is present. The registrant is acting solely as depositor for the trust. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction with no activist, strategic, or structural change.
